audit.whatIsWrong: The packet raises the defect itself: Zaahen wins 53.59% over 1476 games, yet the chart gives Ambessa four stages and Zaahen zero. Full and content agree with each other and the prose agrees with them, so nothing internal is broken — only the win rate disagrees.
audit.why: I will not flip rows on a win-rate argument alone. The prose (whys[1] through whys[6]) is a coherent story of an Ambessa-favoured lane; flipping four badges without flipping that story would put the page back into the two-answers state, and inventing a power shift is worse than leaving a debatable one.
audit.corrected: Chart left untouched and the decision raised in questionsForUser. The mirror audit (ambessa__zaahen) reached the same conclusion and raised the same question.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike says her R 'out-ranges your engage' without the number, and the level-2/3 spike attributes her early power to the wrong abilities.
audit.why: Public Execution is 1250 range on a 130/115/100s cooldown, and Riot's text says it blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in the chosen line, suppresses, then slams and stuns. That targeting rule — not raw range — is what decides who gets picked.
audit.corrected: The farthest-target rule and the 1250 range written into report[5].t and mid; the early spike re-attributed to Drakehound's Step and Lacerate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup is built on a fabricated ability. 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability — it appears in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, ahead, loading, focus.text, four phases, six breakdown fields, both dosFull entries and six report fields. Her real names are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). Worse, the content layer says 'dual dashes on W' — W is Repudiation, a braced shield, and it is the one ability that does NOT dash. Her dashes come from Drakehound's Step, which triggers off any ability cast, and from Lacerate.
audit.why: A player watching for a spell called Repeating Dashes is watching for nothing, and a player waiting for W to be her dash will step in exactly when Repudiation is up. Repudiation also GROUNDS: Zaahen's only escape is his E dash (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s), so her W turns his exit off. That is the decisive interaction of the lane and it was nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Real names and the grounding written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].t/.d, report[5].t, mid, spikes[0].text, whys[1], wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0]. focus.text changed to the real ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere despite fourteen instructions to 'track' a cooldown.
audit.why: Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s and Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9s are the two windows that matter; Cunning Sweep is 14/13/12/11/10s.
audit.corrected: 16s and 11s at rank 3 written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Public Execution heals, so the anti-heal already core in report[8].t and breakdown.late is correctly placed — that satisfies the needs-antiheal missing interaction.

edits.after: - Ambessa Repudiation (16s at rank 3): it grounds — your E dash cannot leave the zone. - Lacerate (11s at rank 3): the dash she escapes on. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
